## Goth Akali

A custom **Goth Akali skin** for League of Legends. Features a custom Akali model with recolored **black and bone-white textures** and a dark goth-inspired visual theme.

Akali’s original animations and gameplay remain intact.

**SFW.**

## Features

- Custom Goth Akali model & textures
- Black and bone-white color palette
- Custom ability VFX and particles
- Custom ability icons
- Custom HUD icons
- Custom loading screen splash art
